evidence.observation: Pressure 2.903 Torr at start of growth, in line with the ramp plateau (~2.90)
Pressure rose steadily to 3.184 Torr (about +0.07 Torr per 120 s), a monotonic climb
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow input did not change and does not explain the rise
Temperature holding at setpoint (750.2 °C) after a brief 760 °C overshoot
Heater power drifting up from 39 to 45.5% at constant T; could be settling after the overshoot
O2 exhaust sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be checked directly

args.missing_evidence: Two things would separate a seal leak from an exhaust blockage: an exhaust O2 or leak-check reading, or a pressure response to a brief Ar flow change or valve isolation (rate-of-rise test). Reference pressure statistics for the growth stage would also help.
